purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: Official Rosreestr regional-office material confirms cadastral accounting and real-estate registration functions for the Chelyabinsk region, and directs users to NSPD’s Public Cadastral Map. Public map features are parcel/property objects identified by cadastral number and other object details; no object search or map selection was made. No safe geometry-only schema/allowlist was verified.
registryAssessment: The Chelyabinsk city-administration FAQ directs residents to Rosreestr’s regional office located in Chelyabinsk for registration matters. Rosreestr’s regional channel describes oblast-wide registration and cadastral-accounting duties. These are separate facts: local city access is confirmed, while registry jurisdiction is regional; neither establishes point coverage.
